references.text: Here the same four cities are mentioned: Gibeon, Kefira, Beeroth and Kiriath-Jearim, which belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.
The reason the Israelites went to these cities was the covenant they had made with the Gibeonites.
Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned as the place where the ark of the covenant was placed after it returned from the Philistines.
Gibeon is described as a large city, one of the royal cities, and its people were known as mighty warriors.
Beeroth is mentioned as the home of some of the Israelites after their return from Babylon.
The Israelites discovered the truth about the Gibeonites three days after they had made a covenant with them.
